questions.question: An e-commerce business is experiencing changing requirements. A company specifically requires Kubernetes orchestration managed by AWS. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?

questions.explanation: Network ACLs provide stateless subnet-level traffic filtering.

questions.question: A company is planning a new workload. An EC2 application needs temporary credentials to read objects from an S3 bucket. Which IAM mechanism should the application use?
questions.explanation: IAM roles provide temporary credentials to trusted entities such as EC2 workloads.

questions.question: A development team is preparing a production deployment. A global application needs traffic to use AWS global network infrastructure for improved performance. Which service should it consider?
questions.explanation: Global Accelerator directs supported traffic through AWS global network infrastructure.

questions.question: A global company is expanding its cloud environment. A company has many terabytes of data and its network connection is too slow for practical migration. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: Snowball devices support secure physical data transfer to and from AWS.

questions.question: A company is planning a new workload. A company wants to replace large upfront purchases of servers with ongoing expenses based on resource consumption. Which financial change is being made?
questions.explanation: Cloud computing can shift spending from capital expenditure toward operational expenditure.

questions.question: What should an AWS customer use when it needs to meet this requirement: A web application uses several EC2 instances and needs incoming requests distributed across them.
questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming traffic across healthy targets.

questions.question: An e-commerce business is experiencing changing requirements. An application repeatedly retrieves the same information and needs lower read latency. Which service can provide in-memory caching?
questions.explanation: ElastiCache provides managed in-memory caching.

questions.question: A global company is expanding its cloud environment. A startup wants to launch an application without purchasing physical servers before demand is known. Which AWS Cloud benefit most directly addresses this requirement?
questions.explanation: Cloud allows resources to be provisioned quickly and expanded as requirements change.

questions.question: Which option is most directly associated with this AWS requirement: A finance team wants to analyze AWS spending by service over previous months.
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer provides visualization and analysis of AWS costs and usage.

questions.question: An organization is migrating an application to AWS. An enterprise customer wants an assigned technical contact for ongoing AWS guidance. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: A TAM provides ongoing technical guidance as part of eligible AWS Support plans.

questions.question: Which option is most directly associated with this AWS requirement: A company must retain compliance records for many years and rarely retrieves them.
questions.explanation: Glacier Deep Archive is designed for long-term archival data that is rarely accessed.

questions.question: A finance and technology team is evaluating an AWS solution. A company has multiple AWS accounts and needs centralized account governance. Which AWS service should it use?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations centrally manages and governs multiple AWS accounts.

questions.question: What should an AWS customer use when it needs to meet this requirement: An EC2 application requires persistent block storage.
questions.explanation: EBS provides persistent block storage volumes for EC2.

questions.question: A development team is preparing a production deployment. A finance team wants to analyze AWS spending by service over previous months. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer provides visualization and analysis of AWS costs and usage.

questions.question: A finance and technology team is evaluating an AWS solution. An application repeatedly retrieves the same information and needs lower read latency. Which service can provide in-memory caching?
questions.explanation: ElastiCache provides managed in-memory caching.

questions.question: What should an AWS customer use when it needs to meet this requirement: A compliance officer needs access to AWS compliance reports and agreements.
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact provides access to AWS compliance documentation and agreements.

questions.question: A security team is reviewing an AWS workload. A security team wants continuous threat detection based on AWS account and workload activity. Which service should it consider?
questions.explanation: GuardDuty continuously analyzes relevant AWS activity and data sources for potential threats.

questions.question: An e-commerce business is experiencing changing requirements. A company wants a managed relational database rather than maintaining the database infrastructure itself. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: RDS is a managed relational database service.

questions.question: Which AWS capability best matches this requirement: A company needs a virtual server with control over the operating system for a legacy application.
questions.explanation: EC2 provides resizable virtual compute capacity with control over the guest OS.

questions.question: A development team is preparing a production deployment. A company needs centralized management of encryption keys used by AWS services. Which AWS service should it use?
questions.explanation: AWS KMS is a managed service for creating and controlling cryptographic keys.

questions.question: A global company is expanding its cloud environment. An organization is migrating many applications and wants centralized visibility into migration progress. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: Migration Hub provides a central place to track application migration progress.

questions.question: A cloud team is reviewing an AWS environment. A company asks how a large cloud provider can reduce the unit cost of infrastructure by serving many customers. Which concept explains this advantage?
questions.explanation: Large-scale infrastructure operations can distribute costs across a large customer base.

questions.question: What should an AWS customer use when it needs to meet this requirement: An application experiences unpredictable demand and should automatically add or remove EC2 instances.
questions.explanation: EC2 Auto Scaling can adjust instance capacity according to configured conditions.

questions.question: A development team is preparing a production deployment. A batch job can tolerate interruption and the company wants to reduce EC2 compute costs. Which purchase option should it consider?
questions.explanation: Spot Instances use spare EC2 capacity at discounted rates and can be interrupted.

questions.question: A development team is preparing a production deployment. A company needs an isolated virtual network for its AWS resources. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon VPC provides logically isolated virtual networking.

questions.question: A security team is reviewing an AWS workload. A company needs managed DNS for its public application. Which TWO options best meet the requirement?
questions.explanation: Route 53 is AWS's managed DNS service.

questions.question: Which option is most directly associated with this AWS requirement: An operations team wants CPU metrics and logs from EC2 instances to troubleshoot an application.
questions.explanation: CloudWatch provides monitoring data such as metrics and logs.

questions.question: A finance and technology team is evaluating an AWS solution. A customer wants personalized information about AWS events that may affect its resources. Which dashboard should it check?
questions.explanation: The AWS Health Dashboard provides personalized AWS service health information.

questions.question: A company is planning a new workload. A company runs an application on an EC2 instance and asks who patches the guest operating system. Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, who performs this task?
questions.explanation: For EC2, customers are responsible for the guest operating system and its patching.
